data.narrative:
Cognition is a Series D-stage AI & Software company that has raised $2.0B to date. The valuation analysis references a universe of 9 peer companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private—across the same sector and comparable or adjacent funding stages. The private peer set includes Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition, providing recent market signals from similar-stage frontier AI businesses.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $1.0B raised proxy as a baseline and applies a typical 1.5x Series D step-up multiplier, yielding an implied valuation of $1.5B. Peer-median analysis draws from four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Figure AI at $39.0B, Skild AI at $14.0B, Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, and Together AI at $8.3B), producing a median of $12.0B and a range of $8.3B to $39.0B. The stage-progression method likely underweights recent market inflation in frontier AI valuations; the peer method likely reflects broader market sentiment but exhibits substantial dispersion.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $1.3B to $13.8B, with a median of $6.8B. The wide spread reflects acute uncertainty around the appropriate comparability of peers and the degree to which stage-progression versus market-based methods should dominate. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, competitive positioning within frontier AI, and near-term financing momentum.
